377:t_1:87.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$ティティ$$ has grown attached to $n. You're the only one who can take charge of her.」

377:t_1:88.en:
$$甲児$$
「Just don't let her do anything unnecessary. The damage $c has taken over these three days is no joke.」

377:t_1:89.en:
$$さやか$$
「On the first day, she tried to paint the right shoulder of every unit red, and...」

377:t_1:90.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Don't you think it'd be a great bluff if everyone were $$レッドショルダー$$?」

377:t_1:91.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I actually wanted to make every unit a $$シャア$$ special, but we ran out of paint.」

377:t_1:93.en:
$$アマタ$$
「On the second day, she tried to sew flower patterns and $$ハロ$$ marks onto everyone's pilot suits, and...」

377:t_1:94.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I picked a mark that suited each person, properly.」

377:t_1:95.en:
$$カレン$$
「So that's why you put a red oni patch on my suit!?」

377:t_1:97.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...Looks like nobody had fun...」

377:t_1:99.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Honestly...! What kind of upbringing did you have? I'd like to see your parents' faces!」

377:t_1:102.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...My dad and my big brother died in the $$時空震動$$...」

377:t_1:104.en:
$$ティティ$$
「And then Mom went strange... and it seems like she started to hate me...」

377:t_1:106.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So I left home... because I didn't want to end up hating Mom...」

377:t_1:107.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「I-I'm sorry, $$ティティ$$... I didn't know you had a situation like that.」

377:t_1:108.en:
$$ティティ$$
「It's okay. I'm having fun now.」

377:t_1:109.en:
$$谷川$$
「All right, got it! If that's how it is, the Daily Life team will look after $$ティティ$$.」

377:t_1:110.en:
$$中原$$
「Even $$ノノ$$, who breaks everything, has become decent strength by now. I'm sure $$ティティ$$ will be able to do it too.」

377:t_1:111.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Thank you! I'll do my best!」

377:t_1:113.en:
$$宗介$$
「That girl lost her parents in the $$時空震動$$ too...」

377:t_1:117.en:
$n
(The reason I feel calm when I look at that girl must be that I sensed something in her that's the same as in me...)

377:t_1:118.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Excuse me! Does anyone know where my $$Ｖコン$$ is!?」

377:t_1:120.en:
$$甲児$$
「No... I haven't seen it, but...」

377:t_1:125.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...Is that the thing that looks like a metal briefcase?」

377:t_1:127.en:
$$ティティ$$
「While I was cleaning $$正太郎$$'s room, someone came and asked to borrow it, so I handed it over.」

377:t_1:128.en:
$$正太郎$$
「You handed it over... to who!?」

377:t_1:131.en:
$$タケル$$
「What in the world is happening!?」

377:t_1:137.en:
$$セイミー$$
「$$鉄人$$ suddenly went on a rampage...」

377:t_1:139.en:
$$セイミー$$
「$$ブラックオックス#pilot$$ tried to stop it, but it broke through the hangar door and went out.」

377:t_1:140.en:
$n
「Is someone controlling $$鉄人$$ with the $$Ｖコン$$!?」

377:t_2:3.en:
???
「Heh heh heh... Your weakness is that you can't abandon $$鉄人$$ and the city and run away.」

377:t_2:4.en:
???
「In the universe, only the strong survive... Earth's humanity, who cannot grasp that principle, is not permitted to live.」

377:t_2:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Found you! You're the one who stole the $$Ｖコン$$!」

377:t_2:7.en:
???
「$$金田正太郎$$, is it... You've done well to corner me this far.」

377:t_2:10.en:
???
「Heh heh heh... So $$マーズ$$ is here as well.」

377:t_2:11.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「How convenient. Let me declare war on you all once again.」

377:t_2:12.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ゲシュタルト$$! You're alive!?」

377:t_2:13.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Having obtained the power of darkness, I am an eternal being.」

377:t_2:14.en:
$$タケル$$
「If you're here... then $$ズール$$ must be too!」

377:t_2:15.en:
$$正太郎$$
「You stole $$鉄人$$'s $$Ｖコン$$ - what are you planning to do!?」

377:t_2:16.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「I have already achieved my purpose. The sun's power will soon vanish.」

377:t_2:18.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Ha ha ha ha ha! I have no use for that thing anymore!」

377:t_2:19.en:
$n
「$$正太郎$$! Stop $$鉄人$$ with the $$Ｖコン$$!」

377:t_2:20.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I-it's no good! The Solar Energy Conversion Device has already gone out of control!」

377:t_2:21.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Ha ha ha ha ha! If you don't want to die, you'd better run!」

377:t_3:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Yeah. We almost turned $$鉄人$$ into a demon.」

377:t_3:6.en:
$$桂$$
「Still, to think that $$皇帝ズール$$ and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ were alive and had teamed up.」

377:t_3:7.en:
$$赤木$$
「They both seem to like darkness and shadows and that sort of thing. I guess that's why they get along.」
